notes: M1 schema window. Every release widens the window, never narrows it inside an expand window: the previous binary must remain usable until the matching contract step has shipped and been observed in the field. Widened to 22 by 0022_observation_hosted_attribution.expand.sql, which is expand-only: it drops a NOT NULL and adds columns and a CHECK, so a binary that predates it reads a database with an extra nullable column and ignores it, which is the direction that window exists to permit. Widened to 23 by 0023_site_isolation_for_every_site_bearing_table.expand.sql, which adds NO column and NO data and only creates policies, so a binary that predates it operates on a database with more predicates than it expects and the difference is entirely in whether a cross-site statement is refused. That is the safe direction for an old binary and is why this migration is expand-only: the row shapes are identical, so a 22-era binary keeps working against a 23 database and simply sees the policies its own code already relied on.
